lead: `grep -rn <pattern> .` from the repo root walks `target/` and times out.
body: It is minutes of I/O over build artifacts for an answer the source tree gives in under a second, and the shell call comes back with nothing at all. Name the roots (`grep -rn <pat> crates docs tests`), use the harness `Grep` tool, which respects the ignore file, or `python tools/peek.py "crates/**/*.rs:re:pattern"` for several such questions in one call.
